variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
